make.sh writes a whole build.nbt; the part line shows 6 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE.

left: Walk verdict is UNREACHABLE only because shell_a is still a stub (no walls, no doors). Re-run `mcd room` after the merged build to confirm the entrance reaches the bed, table and kitchen door.
